D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P F AV

Copper alloy radiate coin of Carausius (AD 286-93) (Reece Period 14), PAX AVG, Pax standing left with branch and vertical sceptre. Unattributed Mint. RIC V, pt 2, p. 535, - ; obverse legend IMP CARAVSIVS P F AV not recorded for type, but several examples known. It is possible that there is a mintmark (poss - // ML) - cf. RIC V, pt 2, p. 472, no. 105. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus…
